frequency_question: How often do central banks activate or raise countercyclical capital buffers when systemic risk policy reviews are conducted?
membership_rule: Includes any scheduled regulatory policy decision by a major central bank regarding macroprudential buffers; excludes ad-hoc emergency liquidity facilities or microprudential capital requirement changes.
coverage_note: 5 major observation points cataloged for the Federal Reserve and peer major central bank framework applications.
known_gaps: Excludes minor jurisdiction changes outside G7 economies.
skeleton: Total regulatory review cycles for CCyB by the Federal Reserve since the framework's inception
multiplier: 1 out of 4 historical review cycles resulted in an active adjustment above 0%
validity_reason: Macroprudential governance frameworks and institutional inertia change slowly over multi-year horizons.
